Brunch just got a whole lot more fabulous 🥞✨ Drag Me to Brunch is landing on the Main Floor and it's bringing FULL sparkle — four queens serving numbers, host Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff running the show, and a plate stacked with pancakes, bacon, sausage, hashbrowns, and eggs sitting right in front of you. All ages, all glam, zero excuses to sleep in. Doors and food service kick off at 11AM, show hits at noon — and mark it now because tickets are pre-sale ONLY, nothing at the door. Grab your squad, grab your appetite, and get ready to eat, laugh, and gag all in one sitting 💅🍳

Sunday, August 30 • Doors & Food at 11AM, Show at Noon
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $5-$15
🎉 All Ages

Picture it: syrup drizzling, sequins catching the light, and a room buzzing before noon even hits ☀️✨ That's Drag Me to Brunch. The clink of forks on plates mixes with the beat drops as four queens turn breakfast into a full production. Bacon sizzling, hashbrowns golden, eggs hot off the line — and somewhere between bites you're watching a number that stops your fork mid-air. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff keeps the whole vibe moving, glitter dust practically floating in the air by the time the show peaks. This isn't just brunch, it's a whole sensory experience wrapped in feathers and flavor. Come hungry, leave dazzled 💫🥓

Bring the whole family, bring your best friend, bring your tía who's never seen a drag show — everybody's welcome at this table 🍽️💕 Drag Me to Brunch is an all-ages celebration where the community shows up as they are, no dress code except maybe extra sparkle. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts a lineup that's as heartfelt as it is hilarious, and the plate in front of you is loaded with pancakes, bacon, sausage, hashbrowns, and eggs so nobody leaves hungry. This is Pasco's Latinx community and beyond coming together for good food and even better performances. Come as you are, laugh with strangers who feel like family by the end, and soak up a Sunday made for connection 🌟

Mark your calendar — here's everything you need for Drag Me to Brunch 📋✨ It's happening Sunday, August 30th at Azucar's Main Floor, hosted by Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff, with doors and food service starting at 11AM and the show kicking off at noon sharp. Menu includes pancakes, bacon, sausage, hashbrowns, and eggs — full plate, full show. This is an all-ages event, so bring the kiddos, bring the grandparents, bring everyone in between. Important: tickets must be purchased in advance, they are NOT available the day of, so lock yours in now before the seats fill up. Glitter, food, and family fun all under one roof 🥞🎤
